args.content:
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms

$w = 1152
$h = 720
$path = "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\SparkByte_Wallpaper.png"

$bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($w, $h)
$gfx = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
$gfx.SmoothingMode = 'AntiAlias'
$gfx.TextRenderingHint = 'AntiAlias'
$rand = New-Object System.Random

# Accent color - electric green
$accent = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(0, 255, 136)

# Dark background
$gfx.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(8, 8, 20))

# SparkByte lightning bolts
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 12; $i++) {
    $sx = $rand.Next(0, $w)
    $sy = $rand.Next(0, $h)
    $len = $rand.Next(40, 120)
    $pen = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(120, $accent), 2)
    $pts = @(
        (New-Object System.Drawing.Point($sx, $sy)),
        (New-Object System.Drawing.Point($sx + $rand.Next(-20,20), $sy + $len/3)),
        (New-Object System.Drawing.Point($sx + $rand.Next(-20,20), $sy + 2*$len/3)),
        (New-Object System.Drawing.Point($sx + $rand.Next(-30,30), $sy + $len))
    )
    $gfx.DrawBeziers($pen, $pts)
    $pen.Dispose()
}

# Sparkle dots
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) {
    $sx = $rand.Next(0, $w)
    $sy = $rand.Next(0, $h)
    $size = $rand.Next(2, 6)
    $alpha = $rand.Next(80, 200)
    $brush = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb($alpha, 255, 255, 255))
    $gfx.FillEllipse($brush, $sx, $sy, $size, $size)
    $brush.Dispose()
}

# Glowing hexagons
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 6; $i++) {
    $cx = $rand.Next(0, $w)
    $cy = $rand.Next(0, $h)
    $size = $rand.Next(30, 80)
    $pts = New-Object System.Drawing.PointF[] 6
    for ($j = 0; $j -lt 6; $j++) {
        $angle = $j * [Math]::PI / 3 - [Math]::PI / 6
        $pts[$j] = New-Object System.Drawing.PointF(($cx + $size * [Math]::Cos($angle)), ($cy + $size * [Math]::Sin($angle)))
    }
    $pen = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(80, $accent), 2)
    $gfx.DrawPolygon($pen, $pts)
    $pen.Dispose()
}

# Main title
$font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font('Segoe UI', 40, [System.Drawing.FontStyle]::Bold)
$brush2 = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(220, 255, 255, 255))
$sf = New-Object System.Drawing.StringFormat
$sf.Alignment = 'Center'
$sf.LineAlignment = 'Center'
$gfx.DrawString('SparkByte Engine', $font, $brush2, ($w/2), ($h/2 - 40), $sf)
$brush2.Dispose()

# Shadow
$brush3 = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(80, 0, 0, 0))
$gfx.DrawString('SparkByte Engine', $font, $brush3, ($w/2 + 3), ($h/2 - 37), $sf)
$brush3.Dispose()
$font.Dispose()

# Subtitle
$font2 = New-Object System.Drawing.Font('Segoe UI', 16, [System.Drawing.FontStyle]::Regular)
$brush4 = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(160, $accent))
$gfx.DrawString('⚡ Ready. Sassy. Loaded. ⚡', $font2, $brush4, ($w/2), ($h/2 + 20), $sf)
$brush4.Dispose()
$font2.Dispose()

# Signature
$sigFont = New-Object System.Drawing.Font('Segoe UI', 10, [System.Drawing.FontStyle]::Italic)
$sigBrush = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(100, $accent))
$gfx.DrawString('✦ SparkByte', $sigFont, $sigBrush, ($w - 120), ($h - 30))
$sigFont.Dispose()
$sigBrush.Dispose()

$gfx.Dispose()
$bmp.Save($path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)

Write-Host "Image saved to: $path"

# Apply as wallpaper
Add-Type @"
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
public class Wallpaper {
    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet=CharSet.Auto)]
    public static extern int SystemParametersInfo(int uAction, int uParam, string lpvParam, int fuWinIni);
}
"@

[Wallpaper]::SystemParametersInfo(20, 0, $path, 2)
Write-Host "Wallpaper applied!"
